title: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
slides: Can Claude’s new Duet agent really work with you—or against you?
It’s designed to collaborate, not just answer questions.
But users report it sometimes second-guesses your simplest requests.
You can now trigger it directly within your workflow for real-time feedback.
Test Duet on one repetitive task—see if its quirks actually help.
thread_text:
1. Duet Works With You?

Claude's new Duet agent is built to collaborate, not just answer. Early users say it sometimes second-guesses your simplest requests.

2. Collaboration, Not Answers

Duet is designed to work alongside you in real time. But that means it can push back on your decisions, even when you're sure.

3. Second-Guessing Basics

Users report Duet questioning trivial requests, like renaming a file. Is it helpful caution or just friction?

4. Trigger In Your Flow

You can now launch Duet directly inside your workflow for instant feedback. No more switching apps or interrupting your focus.

5. Test One Repetitive Task

Try Duet on a single repetitive chore this week. If its quirks save you time, keep it. If not, you'll know fast.
